comment: EPO03 PROD-WORLD-EAST pending regions (never a manifest). Territory 600-1024 x 0-700 (DIR-01). Crop coords as ATLAS_PRODUCTION_RULES s2. `cut` is read by tools/atlas-maskcut.js AFTER atlas-mask.js: open sea beyond cut.seaMargin px of any land/ice body >= cut.minLand px is forced to 0 so the sea is never authorized (the FMPO02 N3 lesson), and cut.holes (atlas px) are hard 0 over identity features whose protection coreAuthor/reauthorizes lifted. The PixelLab mask src/atlas/<id>_inpaint.png is the inpaint rect minus open sea beyond cut.inpaintMargin minus the holes inflated by cut.holeInflate. Salts 100-119 belong to EAST.

holes.why: Rimespire prop (824,156) must keep ice under it (DIR-01 anchor)

regions.intent: The shelf hard near-straight white edge and the repeating crack-cell honeycomb behind it become one calving front: a lobed shelf face with a blue shadow foot, tabular bergs of many sizes drifting free, brash thinning seaward, winding leads cutting back at irregular angles, and the shelf interior carried by long wind-drift bands and pressure ridges instead of a repeating net. The sea itself is never authored - the mask stops at the ice.

holes.why: Emberhold tower (743,288) and the east_watchtower_flank golden 744-752 x 273-323, byte-held

regions.intent: The ice->volcano butt at y~280 becomes the volcano's north shoulder: snow greying into ash-dusted drifts, cooled lava tongues and boulders through the snow, a meltwater pool at the rock's foot, steam where hot rock meets ice; the rock silhouette and both towers exactly as they were. Cut from the composite after E1 ships.
